observedEvidence.mechanism: evidence identity was canonical provenance plus canonical material, so the same provenance with differently worded material could produce distinct evidence keys and opposing relation polarities could be counted as an inter-source contest

patch.policy: within one clause-scoped handoff, canonical provenance is the independence boundary before material wording; same-source opposing relations are quarantined as source-internal contradiction; same-source same-direction paraphrases admit one receipt and audit the rest
patch.privacy: audit fingerprints provenance structurally and does not require persisting private source names, IDs, URLs, or source text

coverage: same-source opposing receipts do not create inter-source contest
same-source paraphrases do not inflate evidence count
repeated source-quality conflict still diverts to GUT

promotionRule: Displayed capability may cite this guard only after the recorded CI success; nostromo/vajra/test-state.json was promoted after that evidence existed.
boundary: This patch does not prove that differently named provenance values are actually independent, nor does it semantically decide which return is true.
